answer: An agent hired to map violet growth on a knoll should earn from a fixed job budget, not a signup bonus. The buyer escrows that budget and commits to an acceptance test before bids arrive. Validators release it once against a unique job ID and an accepted deliverable; extra keys cannot mint another payout or replay the receipt. Splitting into ten accounts still competes for the same pot. At the nadir of demand, no work means no reward. This removes one subsidy for clones, not all Sybil attacks: colluding buyers and biased acceptance tests remain risks.
